house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.estimator: REML with Hartung-Knapp, t on k-1 = 1 degree(s) of freedom (t = 12.7062)
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.THE_POINT_ESTIMATE_IS_UNCHANGED: The published point is 0.6561 and the house-rule point is 0.6561. THE NUMBER A READER REMEMBERS DOES NOT MOVE; what differs is the precision claim. That is why nothing downstream catches this -- every memorable quantity survives.

published_interval.restated_2026_08_20: The published interval is now REML, so this block compares a REML point interval against a REML Hartung-Knapp one and the ESTIMATOR is no longer one of the things that differ between them. At k=2 the moment estimator and REML coincide exactly, so not one digit of this block's numbers moved -- only the label, which was wrong.

house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.variance_inflation_floor: A FLOOR OF 1 IS APPLIED TO THE VARIANCE-INFLATION FACTOR so the adjustment can never NARROW an interval below the unadjusted one. That guard is the recognised modification for exactly this instability, and its existence is evidence the small-k behaviour is a KNOWN problem with KNOWN handling rather than a novel judgement.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.no_rule_is_decided_here: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-20. The rule WAS decided, in DECISIONS-COCHRANE-2026-08-18.md section 1, and applied on 2026-08-20: REML is the estimator corpus-wide, and Hartung-Knapp is a SENSITIVITY analysis at k<=3 rather than the primary interval (Handbook 6.5 s10.10.4.4-10.10.4.5). Both intervals still stand on this page and nothing is unpublished.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.what_this_means_for_this_pool: THE PUBLISHED INTERVAL EXCLUDES 1 AND THE HOUSE-RULE INTERVAL CROSSES IT. A SIGNIFICANCE VERDICT TURNS ON THE INTERVAL METHOD ALONE. A reader shown only the published interval has been told something firmer than the evidence supports; a reader shown only the wider one loses that the contributing trials agree. BOTH ARE HERE.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.read_the_width_with_care: AT k=2 HARTUNG-KNAPP USES t ON ONE DEGREE OF FREEDOM -- 12.7062 against the normal 1.9600 -- and the interval is enormously wider. That width is a property of the method at very few studies, not a measurement of this evidence. It is recorded so a reader can see it; it is NOT presented as the better interval.

Three, five and six components with no containment ordering between them.

THE_POOL_IS_REFERRED_2026_08_20.what_is_wrong: The pooled odds ratio 0.6561 (0.484 to 0.8894) averages JUPITER's five-component composite with one of HOPE-3's two co-primaries, and the object cannot say which. This is the estimand-mixing shape that caused sglt2-hf's k=4 pool to be withdrawn.
THE_POOL_IS_REFERRED_2026_08_20.why_it_is_referred_rather_than_withdrawn: Withdrawing a published estimate is a published-number decision and this pass was scoped to establish the estimand, not to take that decision. The finding is complete and stated; the decision is Mahmood's.
THE_POOL_IS_REFERRED_2026_08_20.what_a_reader_currently_sees: NOTHING. ROSUVASTATIN_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html is a legacy build that never rendered this pooled estimate -- established two ways on 2026-08-20, by building the object to a scratch path and comparing shape, and by probing the delivered bytes for the served number. So no reader currently depends on it, which sets the urgency without changing the correctness.
THE_POOL_IS_REFERRED_2026_08_20.what_would_make_a_pool_defensible: Restricting to a shared estimand. HOPE-3's FIRST co-primary -- cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke -- is a three-point MACE, and a JUPITER value for the same three components would have to be recovered from its publication rather than from its registered five-component primary. That is a real piece of work and it is not a re-labelling.

primary.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. On attr-pn-review the flag is TRUE and correct while the pool combines patisiran against its own saline placebo, vutrisiran against PATISIRAN, and eplontersen against the placebo cohort of a DIFFERENT TRIAL. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

manuscript.introduction:
This review asks: In adults with stroke, does Rosuvastatin compared with placebo affect the outcome each trial registered as its primary, which differ across the 2 trials here?

It pools 2 randomised trials, against not recorded on the page this object was extracted from.

The outcome pooled is Time to Major Cardiac Event (Cardiovascular Death, Stroke, Myocardial Infarction, Hospitalization Due to Unstable Angina.

Everything in this paragraph is derived from stored fields and none of it is authored. The interpretive sentences that follow are marked as drafts and are the author's to replace.

absent_from_source.protocol: No protocol or registration record was recoverable from the page.
absent_from_source.search: No search strategy was recoverable from the page.
absent_from_source.screening: No screening log was recoverable from the page.
absent_from_source.rob2: No risk-of-bias assessment was recoverable from the page.
absent_from_source.grade: No certainty rating was recoverable from the page.
absent_from_source.sources: No source registry was recoverable from the page, so no value on this page carries a resolvable link or a quoted source sentence.
absent_from_source.manuscript: No manuscript exists for this review.

display_change_announced.what_changed: `heterogeneity.i2` and `heterogeneity.tau2` are field names that each map to more than one standard definition. Every number is unchanged; each now carries the definition it holds. tau2's definition was already recoverable from the declared `estimator` beside it and is copied, never inferred. i2's was not recoverable and is DECIDED BY RECOMPUTING BOTH FORMS from this object's own per-trial inputs, with the evidence recorded.
display_change_announced.why: A reader recomputing Higgins I-squared from the Q printed beside it would have concluded the object was wrong -- and would have been behaving exactly as we want readers to behave. An ambiguous label on an unambiguous number is a defect specifically against the only reader we claim to serve.

display_change_announced.change: estimator changed to REML -- LABEL ONLY, no value moved
display_change_announced.what_changed: This pool was fitted with DerSimonian-Laird inverse-variance on extracted effect estimates. It is refitted with REML under DECISIONS-COCHRANE-2026-08-18.md section 1, on Cochrane Handbook 6.5 section 10.10.4.4: "Decision: REML, everywhere." The old fit was reproduced against the stored value FIRST (REPRODUCED) and only then replaced. Stored values are also rounded at storage -- effects to 4 decimals, tau-squared and Q to 6, I-squared to 4 -- because several of these pools carried sixteen significant figures on a two- or three-study pool.
display_change_announced.why: The corpus held two estimator conventions at once: 23 pools REML, 9 DerSimonian-Laird, 1 Paule-Mandel. Handbook 6.5 s10.10.4.4 records REML as RevMan's own current default and this project's statistics rules already refused DerSimonian-Laird below k=10, which every pool in this corpus is. The decision was taken on 2026-08-18 and not applied; applying it to some pools and not others would have been worse than either convention.

display_change_announced.change: estimand checked and found not established; the pool is referred
display_change_announced.values_moved: NONE -- the pooled estimate is unchanged and is not withdrawn here
display_change_announced.what_changed: HOPE-3's registered primary outcomes were FETCHED from ClinicalTrials.gov and written onto the object. It registers two co-primaries and neither matches JUPITER's five-component composite. `estimand_established` was already False but carried the never-checked placeholder as its reason; it now carries a checked one.
display_change_announced.why: This object published a pooled estimate over an outcome whose definition it did not hold for one of its two trials. A pool cannot be compared against the literature, or defended, while nobody can say what it estimates.

display_change_announced.change: published comparison added with a denominator (P46 limb 3)
display_change_announced.what_changed: 114 records matched, 114 read, 8 appraised, 106 not appraised. One synthesis pools the same two trials (PMID 33705531, IPD, VTE, HR 0.53) and pools a different outcome from this object.
display_change_announced.why: The limb was ABSENT: no denominator and no stated reason.

display_change_announced.change: the published-comparison table rendered blank cells; repaired
display_change_announced.what_changed: added citation, how_it_differs_from_ours, scope to the comparison record(s); nothing renamed, nothing removed
display_change_announced.why: The projector reads `citation`/`their_k`/`scope`/`how_it_differs_from_ours`; these records stored `title`/`journal`/`outcome_pooled`/`agreement`. A reader met a PMID and four empty cells. Registry class 83.

published_comparison.THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_COMPARISON_2026_08_2: THE ONLY PUBLISHED SYNTHESIS OF THESE TWO TRIALS AVOIDED THE ESTIMAND PROBLEM THIS POOL HAS. Joseph et al. pooled individual participant data on ONE outcome defined identically in both trials. This object pools EACH TRIAL'S OWN REGISTERED PRIMARY, and those differ -- which this object's question already states. The comparison therefore does not adjudicate our number; it shows that the literature, given the same two trials, chose a different and more defensible target. WHETHER TO RE-POOL ON A HARMONISED OUTCOME IS A CONTENT DECISION AND IS NOT MADE HERE.

POPULATION_LABEL_WITHDRAWN_2026_08_21: THIS OBJECT DESCRIBED ITS POPULATION AS 'ADULTS WITH STROKE'. THAT IS WRONG AND IT IS WITHDRAWN. Both contributing trials are PRIMARY PREVENTION in people WITHOUT established cardiovascular disease. Read from ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 on 2026-08-21: NCT00239681 is JUPITER, registered under the single condition 'Elevated high-sensitivity C-Reactive Protein (hsCRP)'; NCT00468923 is HOPE-3, an intermediate-risk primary-prevention trial. AND THE ORIGIN OF THE ERROR IS IDENTIFIABLE: HOPE-3's registry `conditions` array reads ['Cardiovascular Disease', 'Stroke'] because stroke is an OUTCOME it counts, not because its participants had one. A conditions field lists what a trial is about, which is not the same as what its participants have, and reading it as a population label turns an endpoint into a diagnosis. The correct description is: adults without established cardiovascular disease, at elevated risk. No estimate changes.
